responsibility: This module is GCC’s shared constant-folding and value-range reasoning subsystem for trees and GIMPLE. It combines the generic expression folder and generated match rules (fold-const*, fold-const-call, match.pd) with the numeric foundations needed to evaluate and simplify constants precisely across integer, floating-point, fixed-point, and target-width arithmetic (wide-int, double-int, real, realmpfr, fixed-value, poly-int). On top of those primitives it defines the compiler’s range abstractions and operator semantics (value-range, range, range-op, wide-int-range), including integer, floating, pointer, and mixed-mode transfer functions, storage, equivalence tracking, and pretty-printing used by VRP and ranger. The module also includes the range-driven simplification layer (vr-values) that turns inferred bounds and relations into simplified expressions, conditions, and built-in results. Overall, this is the middle-end infrastructure that proves expression values, canonicalizes them, and propagates conservative numeric facts for optimization and diagnostics, distinguishing it from front-end language semantics and from target-specific code generation modules.
